programme.desc: Jamie prepares a vegetarian feast. Fragrant dishes include a coconut squash curry, fried golden paneer and a smoky aubergine dal, plus minted mango fro-yos. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Together
programme.desc: Jamie reimagines steak and chips with steak and twice-cooked potatoes. Plus, he makes the perfect nibbles, including pesto on mozzarella toast. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Naples. He cooks the beautifully light pasta con vongole. Plus, he ventures to Suffolk and cooks cod with bacon and cabbage. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Goa to explore the ways they cook fresh fish. He cooks turbot vallée d'Auge. Plus, he visits Cornwall and cooks a Goan lobster masala. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Galicia, Spain to explore their seafood dishes. He cooks Almejas a la Marinera. Plus, he visits Leigh-on-Sea and cooks a cockle soup. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein returns to Goa where he cooks a shark vindaloo and dhal with lentils. Plus, he travels to America and cooks Hangtown fry. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Queensland, Australia. He cooks sautéed squid with salad. Plus, he ventures to Italy and cooks seared tuna with salsa verde. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Chesapeake Bay in America. He cooks pan fried bass served with succotash. Plus, he visits Thailand and recreates a tom yum soup. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Hua Hin in Thailand. He cooks a Thai stir-fry. Plus, he goes back to Cornwall and cooks fried fish with a red curry sauce. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein comes to the end of his seafood odyssey journey. He cooks Singapore chilli crab as well as a salt cod, chickpea and parsley stew. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein goes on a pigeon shoot in Cornwall, inspiring him to cook pigeon and peas. Plus, after visiting Devon, he makes a warm skate salad. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein cooks sautéed chicken with 40 cloves of garlic and a warm pheasant salad. Plus, he learns how cider is made at an old-fashioned cider farm in Somerset. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick visits a free-range goose farm in Leicester, inspiring him to tackle a roast goose dish. Plus, he visits the oldest eel and pie shop in London. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick experiences the Lake District's quality produce. He cooks a Chinese-inspired wild boar stew. Plus, he meets a farmer who keeps Herdwick sheep. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein makes the popular steak and kidney pudding as well as poached pears with mascarpone ice cream. Plus, he visits a walled garden in East Sussex. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein forages for golden chanterelles and mushrooms in Norfolk, for a kidney breakfast dish. Plus, he tries charcuterie for the first time. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein visits Yorkshire's largest rhubarb growing area, and then bakes his favourite dessert - a rhubarb crumble. Plus, he makes a delicious rabbit pie. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein explores Wales' amazing produce. He cooks a rice pilaf with Welsh mussels. Plus, he visits a salt marsh lamb farm in North Wales. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein cooks a flavourful boiled mutton with caper sauce. Plus, he visits a family that own highland cattle in Scotland. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein explores Scotland's fantastic produce. He cooks venison with morello cherries and hazelnut spaetzle. Plus, he tries eel straight out of the smoker. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Perfect 10. At Tom's Michelin-starred pub, the team prepare a special dish of rotisserie beef with mushroom tart and walnut ketchup, and a luxurious rice pudding. S2, Ep1

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Memory Lane. There's a trip down memory lane for Tom and his team as they celebrate the pub's 10th anniversary. They make a dish inspired by his childhood. S2, Ep2

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Stateside. Tom serves up delicious pub dishes influenced by America. The menu includes lemon meringue pie, 'dirty' mac and cheese and Caesar salad. S2, Ep3

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Game On. The pub's intense cleaning routine is revealed. Plus, the chefs cook an amazing chilli con carne with slow-cooked venison, rice cream and chocolate. S2, Ep4

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Double Acts. Tom showcases pairs of ingredients that work in harmony. There's turbot with hollandaise, cheese and onion scones and a toffee apple crumble cake. S2, Ep5

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: French Connection. Tom reveals how his training in French-style cookery has influenced the pub's kitchen and menu. He makes clafoutis, cassoulet and frangipane tart. S2, Ep6

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Fast And Fresh. Tom gets a delivery of Isle of Wight tomatoes for an iconic dish that is back on the menu. Plus, she shares three fast, fresh dishes to cook at home. S2, Ep7

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Spice Route. In the pub, a traditional shepherd's pie is given an Indian twist. Plus, Tom cooks lamb curry, Thai fishcakes and spiced pineapple tarte tatin. S2, Ep8

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Good Eggs. Tom showcases the magic properties of eggs. Custard tart is on the menu, and Tom shares how to make foolproof white chocolate and lemon soufflés. S2, Ep9

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets Of The Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian Job. Tom's menu includes wild boar lasagne, sausage and fennel rigatoni and tiramisu pots. Chef Sarah takes control when a rush of orders hits the kitchen. S2, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Wrapped, Pied And Fried. Guy Fieri has it wrapped, pied and fried with craveable carnitas in Mobile, Alabama, elevated pizza in Cody, Wyoming, and brisket in Omaha, Nebraska. S38, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Flavor Explosion. Guy Fieri dives into a flavour overload with next-level tacos in Mobile, Alabama, Indian street food in Alberta, Canada, and vegan twists in Los Angeles. S38, Ep9

programme.title: How Jaws Changed the World
programme.desc: Now 50 years old, Steven Spielberg's Jaws casts a long shadow on both the film industry and the fate of many shark species, leading to widespread slaughter around the world due to the fear it provoked in people. However, the movie also inspired a whole generation of marine biologists to specialise in sharks and this documentary reveals that much more is known now about this misunderstood species than ever before

programme.desc: News, sport and weather from across Scotland

programme.title: Sara Davies' Christmas Craft Off
programme.desc: Sara puts Tameka Empson and Rosie Ramsey to the festive test with angels, tablescapes, bow-making and gift-wrapping that are accompanied by laughter, surprises, and a party to finish

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team of experts, Katie Rushworth, Frances Tophill and David Domoney, creates a modern family garden in Hucknall near Nottingham. The project is a surprise for a landscape gardener who was diagnosed with Alzheimer's at the age of just 32, making him one of the youngest people in the country to develop the condition and leaving him physically unable to complete the garden personally. Alan also provides viewers with some tips on sensory planting and creating home-made play equipment for children

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: The chef's countrywide tour brings him to Exmouth in Devon and a rendezvous with Michael Caines, the owner of Lympstone Manor, a country house hotel and restaurant with stunning views over the River Exe. He gets in the kitchen with Michael to see a Michelin-starred chef at work and then bakes his own lardy cake. James also visits a local vegetable farmer - and cannot resist the chance to drive his tractor - and gathers mussels with fisherman Myles Blood Smyth

programme.title: John and Lisa's Christmas Kitchen
programme.desc: John Torode and Lisa Faulkner have got Christmas covered with classic dishes to serve up for the festive season, starting with sausages three ways and a trio of tempting glazes. The menu also includes a turkey crown with spiced roast root vegetables for a true centrepiece, two family recipes that John and Lisa cannot wait to share, and John's ultimate festive trifle, where he goes all out for a truly sensational pudding to share with family and friends

programme.title: Ainsley's Festive Flavours
programme.desc: Ainsley Harriott throws open the kitchen doors and welcomes friends old and new for a Christmas feast. Actress and comedian Donna Preston pops in for a slice of mouth-watering tamarind, allspice and ginger glazed ham, with a juicy side of pineapple and rum relish, while actor Christopher Biggins joins for a taste of Ainsley's showstopping snow dome dessert, packed with festive flavours. Chef Phil Vickery lends a hand and offers up a party-friendly taste of the sea with his squid, prawn almond patties, and wine expert Jilly Goolden selects drinks for every occasion. Plus, music from classical star Alexis Ffrench

programme.desc: John Torode and Lisa Faulkner present the perfect menu for that time in-between Christmas and New Year, whether for a relaxed family meet-up or a big New Year's Eve party. There is another new creation from Lisa in the form of a Christmas stuffing baked ziti, and a spiced apple and ginger cheesecake with popping candy to start 2026 with a bang

programme.title: Ollchlár Ros na Rún

programme.title: France 24

programme.title: Bréidín & Clúmh

programme.title: CoComelon It's Cody Time

programme.title: Pramsáil
